fact: The board of the national regulator ARN-TIC put the draft Electronic Transactions Law (covering electronic communications and transactions, trust services and e-government) out for public consultation, with responses due by 28 May 2026; the notice's date is not given, so the published date 2026-05-08 is used.
system: Projeto de Lei das Transações Eletrónicas

fact: The document is the 112-article Projecto de Lei das Transacções Electrónicas de 2025 (bill number and publication date left blank, masthead dated 6 September 2025), which would give data messages, electronic records, contracts and electronic signatures legal effect, license trust-service providers and set e-commerce consumer rules, and which enters into force only on a date the Minister designates; ARN put this revised text to public consultation, dated here by the document's published date 2026-05-08.
